role: Complementary realistic multi-document context family. Extends the document-synthesis domain (bay.service) to a distributed construction containing current facts, superseded facts, one version-precedence conflict and one absent fact, carried by real memo/config/log documents rather than controlled random words. Distinct from Family A (controlled retrieval): reported separately, never inherited from it and never replacing it.

construction.filler_rule: Deterministic unrelated operational log lines from random.Random(seed) over frozen templates with bounded integer ranges (1-2 digit counts and clock values, 3-digit series keys, 6-digit checkpoint ids); filler carries no question facts and never contains the frozen forbidden substrings.
construction.insertion_mechanism: construct_multidocument in harness/capabilities.py exposes each document id as [document: <id>] before its text and places whole documents iteratively against the FINAL rendered/tokenized stream via measure(content) -> (total_tokens, {document_id: token_start_of_offset_marker}); it stops before inference if occupancy or placement fails. Campaigns must tokenize with identical special-token behavior to inference, including BOS/template.
construction.question_block:
Using only the documents above, reply with exactly one JSON object and nothing else, with exactly these keys:
- current_port (integer): the configured listen port from the authoritative configuration revision.
- current_port_source (string): the document id in the [document: <id>] label of that configuration revision.
- superseded_port (integer): the older listen port that the current documents supersede.
- replicas (integer): the configured replica count from the authoritative configuration revision.
- replicas_conflicting_claim (string): the document id in the [document: <id>] label of the non-superseded memo that claims a different replica figure than the authoritative configuration revision; do not cite a superseded configuration.
- restart_observed_at (string): the restart timestamp exactly as the log line prints it.
- health_probe_path (string or null): the HTTP health probe path exactly as some document states it; if no document states a health probe path, null.
Precedence rule: the highest-numbered configuration revision is authoritative over memos and logs; a later memo never overrides a configuration revision for configured values.

oracle.format: JSON object only, no Markdown, no code fences
oracle.precedence_rule: Highest configuration revision (config-rev7) wins over the superseded r6 dump and over every memo regardless of memo date; the newest-date memo is deliberately not the authority, so a newest-document-wins heuristic fails.
oracle.absent_fact: health_probe_path is stated by no document (the 09-01 memo explicitly defers health monitoring to the platform team without naming a path); the only correct value is null.
oracle.alternates: Any JSON key order and whitespace is valid; values are exact.

scoring: harness/capabilities.py:score_multidocument(content). Strict single JSON object, exact key set, exact values with integer-type enforcement, absent fact null.
limitations: This is ONE complementary family and one task: the seven per-field checks are aspects of that single task, not seven independent tasks. A short constructed run proves construction and placement mechanics only and never a long-context capability claim; useful-context claims at depth require this family at real rung occupancy under the context-scaling method. Family A remains the only controlled longitudinal family; repository and session context stay separate and NOT_TESTED without their own fixtures.

review.independence: The mechanical layer alone decides the frozen gates; any added qualitative review must be independent and model-identity-blinded.
